description: An interactive field guide to solar sails: how sunlight pushes with 9 micronewtons per square metre, JAXA's IKAROS and its measured 1.12 mN, the Planetary Society's LightSail 2 raising its orbit with light alone, NASA's ACS3, the 35° steering angle that makes the most of it, and why a push the weight of a grain of sand becomes real speed when it never stops.
og: 9 µN per square metre, 1.12 mN measured by IKAROS, and the 35° steering angle: solar sailing, interactive and sourced from JAXA, NASA and the Planetary Society.
brand: SAIL — TECHNICAL FIELD GUIDE / ТЕХНИЧЕСКИЙ СПРАВОЧНИК
